name: Sidespin: Table Tennis
summary:
Pick up the bat and play table tennis the way it really feels. Sidespin tracks your bat 1:1 and simulates every contact 360 times a second with physics checked against lab measurements: topspin dips, backspin floats and sidespin curves, exactly as you hit them.

CAREER MODE
